meta_title: J R Plumbing | Emergency Plumber Sunderland
meta_description: J R Plumbing in Sunderland. Emergency plumbing, repairs, and installations. Fast response, trusted local service. Call now for urgent help.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe, blocked drain, or boiler failure in Sunderland? We're here within the hour, day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full system installations, we handle all your plumbing needs with speed and skill.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes & Leaks
services.desc: Pipe burst at 2am? We're out within the hour, any day of the week. We locate the leak, stop the damage, and repair it properly — no mess left behind.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: Cold radiators, low pressure, or strange noises? Our engineers diagnose faults quickly and source parts same-day. Annual servicing keeps your heating running efficiently.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Toilets
services.desc: Slow drainage or backing up? We use high-pressure jetting and drain cameras to clear blockages without damaging your pipes. Fixed fast, guaranteed.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Repair
services.desc: Cold spots on your radiator? We bleed, repair, and replace radiators with minimal disruption. New heating systems designed for your home's layout and budget.

services.title: Tap & Mixer Installation
services.desc: Leaky tap or outdated kitchen mixer? We fit modern, water-efficient taps that look great and work reliably for years. Same-day fitting available.

services.title: Central Heating System Installation
services.desc: Upgrading your heating? We design and install efficient systems, handling all pipework, boiler fitting, and testing. Energy-efficient options with full warranty.

about_pullquote: We started this business to prove plumbers don't have to overcharge or keep you waiting.
about_para_1: J R Plumbing has served Sunderland's homes and businesses for 18 years. What began as one engineer with a van has grown into a trusted local team, handling everything from emergency midnight bursts to full central heating overhauls. We've built our reputation on honest pricing, fast turnaround, and showing up when we say we will.
about_para_2: Our customers know us because we answer the phone, we show up on time, and we fix the problem right the first time. We're not interested in shortcuts or selling work you don't need. That's why families and business owners across Sunderland call us back, again and again.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe on a Sunday morning and J R Plumbing was here within 45 minutes. Really professional, sorted the leak and didn't charge a fortune. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: My boiler stopped working in the middle of winter. Called first thing and they came out same day, found the problem, and got it running again. Fair price too. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Linda P.

reviews.text: Blocked drain nightmare — J R Plumbing unblocked it with a jet and camera in under an hour. Professional job, no mess, explained everything as they went. Top service.
reviews.author: David M.
